name: prompt-chaining
context: Fixed, well-understood workflows decomposed into sequential LLM steps, each transforming the previous output with a gate check before the next step runs.
avoid_when: Steps are unknown at design time
Steps must be executed conditionally based on intermediate output
design_principles: Define explicit handoff schema per step boundary
Validate parsed output before passing to next step
Use model mixing: reasoning model for complex steps, cheap model for extraction
best_practices: Retry with feedback on gate failure
Trace every hop: capture model, prompt id, input/output tokens, latency, cost
Use reasoning model only for steps requiring deep reasoning; cheap models for extraction/formatting
Split chain when: multiple reasoning modes needed, mid-workflow inspection required, different models/temps per stage
references: Wu et al., AutoGen: Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation, 2023 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.08155
Agent Patterns Catalog, Prompt Chaining pattern — https://www.agentpatternscatalog.org/patterns/prompt-chaining/
